context: Mei and Aoi cheer each other up.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (ストレス/思える/恐れ/すばらしい/早速) in natural home.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 最近、なんだかストレスが多くて。
lines.en: Lately I've somehow had a lot of stress.
lines.style: tired barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 頑張りすぎてるように思えるよ。
lines.en: It seems like you're overdoing it.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 失敗を、恐れちゃうんだよね。
lines.style: honest barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 恐れずに、挑戦していいんだよ。
lines.en: You can challenge yourself without fear.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm encouraging delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あなたの言葉、すばらしいね。
lines.style: moved barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: すばらしいあなたを、応援してるよ。
lines.style: warm woman voice, soft warm tender delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 早速、気持ちが軽くなった!
lines.en: Right away, my heart feels lighter!
lines.style: brightening barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ストレスを、ためずにいこうね。
lines.en: Let's keep from bottling up stress.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
